tuesday.label: Lower A (Quads / Hamstrings / Glutes)
tuesday.warmup: 5–7 min easy recumbent bike or flat walk, left arm relaxed. No rowing, bands or arm-supported drills. Continue only if symptoms are stable/improving and setup is comfortable without left-hand gripping. One very light practice set per machine; keep at least 4 reps in reserve. Stop any movement that provokes the forearm.
tuesday.cooldown: 3–5 min easy flat walk, then comfortable seated breathing with the left arm supported. Follow clinician-directed gentle elbow movement only. No forearm stretches, doorway stretches, quadruped positions, planks or generic video substitutions. No pressure through the left hand/elbow.

exercises.notes: Provisional light starting pin, no prior baseline. Use the lightest comfortable pin and enter its actual weight. Left arm relaxed; do not copy pictured handle gripping. Skip if safe setup or stabilization needs the left hand. Keep 4+ reps in reserve; no increases this week.

Reduced from prior 75–85-lb work. Thigh pad must stabilize you without left-hand gripping; this week's cue overrides the generic handle-grip instruction. If the machine requires both hands, skip it. Reduce weight for any strain; 4+ reps in reserve.

Reduced from prior 95-lb work. Comfortable middle range, no torso rocking. Left arm relaxed, no handle grip or arm brace; skip if needed for safe use. Stop if hip/groin pain returns. No progression this week.
No dumbbell, barbell or band. Left arm comfortably supported, no pressing into mat. Small comfortable lift through the feet, breathe normally. Omit if getting down/up needs the injured arm.

wednesday.label: Easy Cardio + Core A
wednesday.warmup: Cardio is today's main block: 20 min recumbent bike or flat walking total = 5 min very easy + 12 min easy steady pace + 3 min easing down. Left arm relaxed; no handle gripping, railing support or rowing. RPE 2–3, full-sentence conversation. Then the short core block below if floor entry/exit is safe. Stop for forearm symptoms; record actual cardio minutes in session notes.
wednesday.cooldown: The 3-min easing-down phase is already included in the cardio block before core. Finish with seated relaxed breathing, left arm supported. No loaded arm work, arm stretches, floor support on elbows/hands or generic cooldown video substitutions.

exercises.notes: 12 alternating repetitions total = 6 per leg. Arms rest comfortably throughout; ignore raised arms in the reference image. Start with a small bent-knee heel tap, only as far as your back stays comfortable. No left-arm reach or pressure into floor. Omit if setup or movement provokes the forearm. Record 20-min easy cardio and symptom response in session notes.

thursday.label: Lower B (Repeat Comfortable Loads)
thursday.warmup: 5–7 min easy bike or flat walk with left arm relaxed. Review Tuesday's later-day and next-morning forearm response before repeating anything. One very light practice set per machine. If symptoms worsened, omit the provoking movement; do not compensate with extra sets. No painful gripping or arm brace.
thursday.cooldown: 3–5 min easy flat walk and comfortable seated breathing with left arm supported. No forced forearm stretch, hand-held quad stretch, quadruped position or arm-supported cooldown. Follow only the clinician's gentle elbow-motion guidance.

exercises.notes: Repeat Tuesday's comfortable actual load, or less; no increase. No left-hand handle grip. Skip if correct operation/stability needs both hands or Tuesday increased forearm symptoms. Keep 4+ reps in reserve.

Repeat Tuesday's comfortable starting pin, or less; enter actual weight. Left arm relaxed, no copying the image's handle grip. Skip if setup or stabilization needs the left hand. No grinding or load progression.
Same comfortable range and load as Tuesday, or less. No left-arm grip/brace or torso rocking; skip if required for safety. Stop for any returning hip/groin pain.
Repeat only if Tuesday and the following morning were comfortable. No added load and no pushing into the mat with the arm. Safe transitions without left-hand/elbow support are required.

friday.label: Easy Cardio + Core B
friday.warmup: 20 min recumbent bike or flat walking total = 5 min very easy + 12 min easy steady pace + 3 min easing down. Repeat Wednesday's comfortable duration; shorten if fatigue or symptoms increased. Keep the left arm relaxed and supported as needed; no painful grip or railing support. RPE 2–3, no intervals. Then the short core block if safe; note actual cardio minutes and symptoms.
friday.cooldown: The 3-min easing-down phase is already included in the cardio block before core. Finish with seated relaxed breathing, left arm supported. No forearm stretch, loaded arms, arm-supported floor positions or generic video substitutions. Review symptoms before planning next week.

exercises.notes: 6 per leg, alternating, 12 total. Repeat Wednesday's comfortable range; arms remain resting and supported, unlike the raised-arm reference image. No arm press into mat. Skip for unsafe floor transitions or forearm symptoms. Cardio duration and symptom response belong in session notes.
